# Quản Lý Hồ Sơ BHXH (QLHS)

## Project Overview
Hệ thống quản lý hồ sơ tiếp nhận và trả kết quả Bảo hiểm Xã hội (BHXH) — a Vietnamese Social Insurance document tracking and management system for government administrative staff.

## Purpose
This application helps BHXH (Social Insurance) officers:
- Track and manage incoming documents (Hồ Sơ Tiếp Nhận - TNHS)
- Handle resolution-based documents (Nghị Quyết - NQT)
- Manage public administrative transfers (Hành Chính Công - HCC)
- Generate and manage handover records (Biên Bản Bàn Giao - BBBG)
- Report and analyze document processing statistics (Báo Cáo)
- Maintain master data: departments (Đơn Vị), procedures (Thủ Tục), holidays (Ngày Lễ)

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS (dark retro navy/orange theme)
- UI Components: Radix UI + custom components
- Icons: Phosphor Icons + Lucide React
- Animation: Framer Motion
- Database/Auth: Anima Playground React SDK (hosted backend)
- State: React Context API

## Key Sections / Routes (hash-based)
- `/` or `/#dashboard` — Main dashboard with KPI metrics and quick actions
- `/#tnhs` — Hồ Sơ Tiếp Nhận: receive and track social insurance documents
- `/#nqt` — Hồ Sơ Nghị Quyết: resolution-based document management
- `/#hcc` — Hành Chính Công: public administration document transfers
- `/#bbbg` — Biên Bản Bàn Giao: handover record management
- `/#baocao` — Báo Cáo & Thống Kê: reports and statistics
- `/#danhmuc` — Danh Mục: master data management (DonVi, ThuTuc, NgayLe)

## Target Users
Vietnamese social insurance government staff (cán bộ BHXH) responsible for document intake, processing, and return within regulated deadlines.

## Language
Primary language: Vietnamese (vi-VN)

## Access
Authentication required. Default credentials managed by system administrator.
